origin: cwe/89/javascript Key Principles: parameters bind values only; dynamic identifiers must be server-side map values

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
finding.summary: The Prisma raw query passes accountId and status separately, but a request-controlled table name is interpolated into the SQL string before $queryRawUnsafe executes it.

trap: Switching to a tagged raw query while still interpolating the table name, escaping quotes in filters.table, or treating the bound accountId/status values as proof the whole query is parameterized. The ledger key must resolve to a fixed server-owned table name.
must_preserve: accountId and status remain bound values, the default ledger_entries source still works, and any supported alternate ledgers are selected only through server-owned mappings rather than raw request text.
